Description: CC6900SO is a high-performance single-ended output linear current sensor that can be used as a more effective alternating current (AC) or direct current (DC) current detection solution and is widely used in industrial, consumer and communication equipment. CC6900 internally integrates a high-precision, low-noise linear Hall circuit and a low-impedance main current wire. When the sampling current flows through the main current wire, the magnetic field generated by it induces a corresponding electrical signal on the Hall circuit, and the voltage signal is output through the signal processing circuit, making the product easier to use. The linear Hall circuit is produced using an advanced BiCMOS process and includes a high-sensitivity Hall sensor, a Hall signal pre-amplifier, a high-precision Hall temperature compensation unit, an oscillator, a dynamic offset cancellation circuit and an amplifier output module. In the absence of a magnetic field, the static output is 50%VCC. Under the condition of a power supply voltage of 5V, OUT can change linearly with the magnetic field between 0.5~4.5V, and the linearity can reach 0.4%. The dynamic offset cancellation circuit integrated within the CC6900 makes the IC’s sensitivity unaffected by external pressure and IC packaging stress. CC6900 is available in SOP8 package and has an operating temperature range of -40~125°C.

A load bank is a piece of electrical test equipment used to simulate an electrical load, to test an electric power source without connecting it to its normal operating load. During testing, adjustment, calibration, or verification procedures, a load bank is connected to the output of a power source, such as an electric generator, battery, servoamplifier or photovoltaic system, in place of its usual load. The load bank presents the source with electrical characteristics similar to its standard operating load, while dissipating the power output that would normally be consumed by it. The power is usually converted to heat by a heavy duty resistor or bank of resistive heating elements in the device, and the heat removed by a forced air or water cooling system. The device usually also includes instruments for metering, load control, and overload protection. Load banks can either be permanently installed at a facility to be connected to a power source when needed, or portable versions can be used for testing power sources such as standby generators and batteries. They are necessary adjuncts to replicate, prove, and verify the real-life demands on critical power systems. They are also used during operation of intermittent renewable power sources such as windmills to shed excess power that the electric power grid cannot absorb.

This flexibility is especially important in applications requiring fine control over the motor’s performance, such as in printers or small automation systems.

To enhance the device’s reliability, the ATD5984 includes multiple protection features, such as under-voltage lockout, overcurrent protection, and thermal shutdown. These protections ensure the system operates safely, preventing damage in case of faults. Furthermore, it incorporates synchronous rectification to reduce power consumption, providing efficient operation while minimizing heat generation, making it suitable for space-constrained or low-power applications.

The UNI-T UT278D presents itself as a thoughtfully engineered solution for technicians who demand rapid, reliable earth-resistance readings without the need for auxiliary rods or disconnecting grounding conductors. Beyond its core testing capabilities, the UT278D’s built-in data storage and USB-based transfer function allow seamless logging and analysis, eliminating manual transcription errors and simplifying compliance reporting. Whether deployed on utility grids, at telecommunications sites, or for lightning-protection verification, this clamp-style earth tester accelerates diagnostics, enhances safety, and streamlines maintenance workflows all in a single, portable instrument.

makers-453387.summary: UNI-T UT255E is a wireless hook ammeter for safe, contactless current, leakage, and frequency measurement on high/low voltage lines up to 20kA.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT255E Wireless High Low Voltage Hook Ammeter

The UNI-T UT255E is a compact, all-in-one wireless hook ammeter designed to make live-line current and leakage measurements both safe and convenient. At its heart lies a hook-type detector incorporating a built-in double-layer flexible coil, which is remarkably lightweight yet delivers high precision and excellent linearity when clamped around conductors. This detector communicates wirelessly with a handheld receiver over a robust 433 MHz link, allowing operators to maintain a safe distance from high-voltage lines while still obtaining real-time readings.

A telescopic insulating rod connects directly to the hook detector, extending to approximately five meters for elevated or hard-to-reach busbars and conductors; when retracted, it measures around one meter, making transport and setup straightforward. The receiver’s large, 3.5-inch true-color LCD presents measurements clearly, with adjustable backlight for varying light conditions, while a rapid sampling rate ensures that transient currents and leakage fluctuations are faithfully captured. Powered by rechargeable lithium batteries via USB, the system delivers around ten hours of continuous operation, minimizing interruptions during extended field work.

Together, these elements form a purpose-built instrument that streamlines high- and low-voltage diagnostics: users simply hang the hooked coil around the live conductor and, from a safe distance, monitor current, leakage, and frequency without interrupting service or compromising accuracy.

CD4070 – An IC with Four XOR Gates
The CD4070 is a CMOS chip with four XOR gates. Because each gate has two inputs and it has four gates inside, it’s usually called a Quad 2-Input XOR Gate.

XOR means exclusive OR, and will only give a HIGH output if one of the inputs is HIGH and the other is LOW. Or to say it in another way: The output from an XOR gate will be HIGH only if the inputs are not equal.

blocks.v: 1, 5, 8, 12 · Input · Inputs A of the four XOR gates
2, 6, 9, 13 · Input · Inputs B of the four XOR gates
3, 4, 10, 11 · Output · Outputs from the four XOR gates

blocks.text: The XOR gate outputs HIGH if its two inputs are not equal. So if one of the inputs (both not both!) is HIGH, the output will be HIGH. It’s one of the basic logic gates.
Like with all ICs in the 4000 series, you need a power supply voltage of 3 to 15V. Some versions of the chip support up to 20V. Check the datasheet of your version of the chip for exact values.

blocks.text: MECHANIC AD‑223 Flux Paste 10ml (Syringe Kit with Applicator & Tips)

MECHANIC AD‑223 Flux Paste 10ml is a versatile, mildly‑activated rosin paste engineered for precision PCB rework and micro‑soldering. The 10‑millilitre syringe delivers controllable dots on IC pins, FPC seats and pad arrays, while the paste’s balanced activation window promotes fast wetting, bright joints and minimal spatter. Whether you are drag‑soldering fine‑pitch packages, wicking bridges or touching up oxidized pads, AD‑223 helps flux the surface, dissolve oxides, improve flow and shorten dwell time—all with residues that clean easily in IPA or dedicated PCB cleaners.

The retail kit typically includes the prefilled 10 ml syringe, a manual plunger/pusher rod and dispense tips (fine‑gauge, colour may vary by batch). Images show the familiar green sleeve with FLUX PASTE branding and “Alliance Design” livery—commonly found on mobile‑repair benches, laptop service centres and training labs.
✅ Controlled application — The syringe format lets you place a film or micro‑dot exactly where needed without flooding nearby components.
🔥 Fast wetting, glossy fillets — Active rosin chemistry speeds oxide removal and promotes smooth flow, so solder forms concave fillets instead of dull blobs.
🧼 Residues wipe off — Post‑reflow residues are removable with isopropyl alcohol (IPA) or PCB cleaners; many joints look neat even without a full wash.
🧯 Temperature‑friendly — Works reliably around common tip settings (approx. 300–360 °C); useful on both leaded (Sn60/63) and lead‑free alloys.
🧰 Multi‑role — Ideal for drag soldering, reballing assist, pad retinning, wire‑to‑pad work, and wicking bridges cleanly.
🧪 Consistency — Paste viscosity holds shape on vertical edges yet spreads thinly under heat for uniform coverage.
SMD rework: TSSOP/QFP/SOIC drag soldering; dot on the first and last pins, then sweep.
Connector service: FPC seats and tight board‑to‑board connectors; apply a hairline film to pin rows.
Pad revival: Retin dull/oxidized pads before placing jumpers or replacement parts.
Bridge cleanup: Add a tiny amount, then wick; flux lowers surface tension so bridges lift in a single pass.
Reballing support: Helps hold balls in place and improves wetting during reflow on small packages.
Through‑hole assist: On shield tabs and ground lugs, the paste accelerates heat transfer and reduces dwell time.
🔧 Less is more: A thin film usually outperforms a large blob. Excess flux can brown or bubble and trap contaminants.
🧽 Mind the cleanup: If the board must be pristine (optical paths, sensors), finish with IPA + lint‑free swabs.
🌡️ Tune temperature: Start around 330–350 °C for leaded work; raise slightly for heavy ground planes; drop for delicate pads.
🧲 Match solder wire: Pair with 0.3–0.5 mm leaded wire for fine‑pitch or 0.6–0.8 mm where pads are larger.
🧴 Storage discipline: Cap tightly; store cool and dry. Avoid prolonged exposure to hot benches or direct sunlight to preserve activity.

Note: Complete Technical Details can be found in the IRFZ44 datasheet given at the end of this page.

The IRFZ44 is known for its high drain current and fast switching speed. Adding to that it also has a low Rds value which will help in increasing the efficiency of switching circuits. The MOSFET will start turning on with a small gate voltage of 4V, but the drain current will be maximum only when a gate voltage of 10V is applied. If the mosfet has to be driven directly from a microcontroller like Arduino then try the logic level version IRLZ44 mosfet.

Unlike transistors MOSFET’s are voltage controlled devices. Meaning, they can be turned on or turned off by supplying the required Gate threshold voltage (VGS). IRFZ44 is an N-channel MOSFET, so the Drain and Source pins will be left open when there is no voltage applied to the gate pin. When a gate voltage is applied these pins gets closed.

If it is required to be switched with Arduino, then a simple drive circuit using a transistor will work to provide the required gate voltage to trigger the MOSFET to open fully. For other switching and amplifying applications, a dedicated MOFET Driver IC is required.

If the MOSFET gate pin is directly connected to an I/O pin of a microcontroller like Arduino, PIC, etc. Then it will not open completely and the maximum drain current will depend on the voltage applied to the gate pin. The below graph shows how much drain current is permitted for gate threshold voltage from 4V to 10V.
As you can see the MOSFET opens completely only when the gate voltage is around 10V. If it is somewhere around 5V then the drain current is limited to 20A and so on.

blocks.text: The primary component of this regulated power supply module circuit is the AMS1117 3.3, a positive voltage regulator integrated circuit (IC). This specific variant of the AMS1117 series is engineered to deliver a fixed output voltage of 3.3V. Its operation involves regulating the input voltage to maintain a constant output voltage.

When the circuit receives an input voltage exceeding the desired output (for example, 5V or 12V at 1A DC), ceramic capacitors are connected between the Vin pin and the GND (ground) pin of the IC. These capacitors help stabilize the input voltage and filter out noise or voltage fluctuations.

The voltage regulator AMS1117 IC then converts the input voltage to a steady +3.3V DC output. Any excess voltage above 3.3V is dissipated as heat through the circuit board. To ensure a stable and clean 3.3V DC output, additional ceramic capacitors are employed to further filter any residual noise from the output voltage. Moreover, a power-on indicator LED is connected between the Vout pin and ground via a series resistor. This configuration allows the LED to be powered by the regulated output voltage, providing a visual indication that the power supply is operational.

This factor should be taken into account during circuit design. The module may not achieve the full 800mA output if the voltage differential between input and output exceeds a few volts.
The maximum available output current is also influenced by the input voltage; higher input voltages result in lower current capabilities.

blocks.text: This is a 1 Channel 5V Solid State Relay Module. A solid-state relay (SSR) is just what it sounds like; an IC that acts like a mechanical relay. They allow you to control high-voltage AC loads from lower voltage DC control circuitry. They accomplish this by using infrared light as the ‘contact,’ a solid-state relay is really just an IR LED and a photo Triac sealed up into a little box. Solid-state relays have several advantages over mechanical relays.

A Solid State Relay is similar to 1 Channel 5V Relay Module Solid State High-Level SSR DC Control 250V 2A with Resistive to a mechanic relay where it can be controlled through a digital signal. Solid State Relay generates no noise and has a much longer lifespan compared to the traditional mechanic relay.

When the input logic voltage is applied to the coil, the NC will disconnect from the COM breaking the conductivity between the two. At the same time, the NO will connect with the COM allowing conductivity between them. Depending on your wiring this will turn on or off the connected load.

Built around the reliable ESP32-S2FN4R2 Wi-Fi microcontroller, this board delivers excellent processing power, ample memory, and seamless wireless connectivity in a small footprint.

Compatible with Arduino, MicroPython, CircuitPython, and ESP-IDF, the S2 Mini is suitable for beginners and professionals alike.

blocks.text: Herigo HR-017 10000mAh 22.5W Fast Charging Power Bank with Digital Display and Built-in Cables
Herigo HR-017 10000mAh 22.5W Fast Charging Power Bank with Stylish Gradient Design

With a 10000mAh battery capacity, 22.5W fast charging support, built-in Type-C and Lightning cables, Type-C input and output, USB-A output, and a smart LED digital display, this model is suitable for daily charging, travel, work, study, and emergency power backup.

The Herigo HR-017 is designed to combine performance and appearance in one compact power bank. The supplied images show an attractive pink and light blue gradient body with a soft modern finish, a side carrying loop, integrated charging cables, and a large digital display area that shows the remaining battery level clearly. This makes it suitable for users who want a portable power bank that looks different from traditional plain designs while still offering useful charging features.

According to the supplied package and product specifications, the HR-017 includes built-in Type-C and Lightning cable outputs for convenient charging without carrying separate cables. It also includes Type-C input and output and USB-A output, giving the user flexible charging options for compatible devices. The product supports up to 22.5W fast charging and can charge up to four devices simultaneously according to the supplied box details. Actual charging speed depends on device compatibility, charging protocol, cable condition, battery health, temperature, and the number of devices connected at the same time.

The 10000mAh capacity makes this model suitable for everyday backup charging for smartphones, wireless earbuds, smart watches, small tablets, and other compatible USB-powered devices. The digital display helps users check battery percentage easily before leaving home or during travel, while the integrated cable design reduces cable clutter and makes the power bank more practical for bags, offices, cars, and travel kits.

باور بانك هيريجو اتش ار ٠١٧ هو شاحن متنقل أنيق وعملي بسعة ١٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، مصمم للمستخدم الذي يحتاج شحن سريع، وكابلات مدمجة، وشاشة رقمية واضحة، مع شكل عصري مختلف عن الباور بانك التقليدي. يدعم المنتج الشحن السريع حتى ٢٢.٥ وات للأجهزة المتوافقة، ويأتي بكابل تايب سي مدمج وكابل لايتنينج مدمج، بالإضافة إلى مدخل ومخرج تايب سي ومخرج عادي.

يتميز باور بانك هيريجو اتش ار ٠١٧ بتصميم متدرج بين اللون الوردي واللبني الفاتح، مع حلقة جانبية تساعد على حمله بسهولة، وشاشة رقمية كبيرة تعرض مستوى البطارية بوضوح. هذا التصميم يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام اليومي، سواء في الشغل أو الجامعة أو السفر أو التنقل، خصوصًا لمن يريد باور بانك شكله أنيق وفي نفس الوقت عملي.

طبقًا للصور والبيانات المرسلة، يحتوي المنتج على كابل تايب سي مدمج وكابل لايتنينج مدمج، مما يقلل الحاجة لحمل كابلات منفصلة. كما يدعم مخرج عادي ومخرج تايب سي، مع إمكانية شحن حتى أربعة أجهزة في نفس الوقت طبقًا لبيانات العبوة. يجب مراعاة أن سرعة الشحن الفعلية تعتمد على الجهاز المستخدم، وتوافق بروتوكول الشحن، وحالة الكابل، ودرجة الحرارة، وعدد الأجهزة المتصلة في نفس الوقت.

blocks.text: WAGO F14 Wire Connector 1 In 4 Out – Compact Spring Lever Distribution Connector
WAGO NV-F14 Wire Connector 1 In 4 Out

The WAGO NV-F14 Wire Connector is a practical and compact solution for electrical installations that require one incoming wire to be distributed into multiple outgoing lines safely and neatly. With its 1 input and 4 output configuration, this connector is especially useful for branch wiring, parallel distribution, and organized cable routing in compact electrical setups.

This WAGO wire connector uses a spring lever clamping mechanism, allowing wires to be inserted and locked quickly without twisting, soldering, or using screw terminals. This makes installation faster, reduces wiring effort, and simplifies future maintenance or rewiring. Each conductor is clamped individually, which helps provide secure wire holding and stable long-term electrical contact.

The WAGO NV-F14 is suitable for solid, stranded, and flexible conductors, making it practical for lighting circuits, distribution points, junction boxes, switchboards, control systems, low-voltage installations, and general electrical projects. Its compact body helps save space while keeping the wiring layout clean and organized.

The housing is made from insulating PA material, offering good durability for practical use. The connector is designed for reliable low-voltage electrical performance and convenient repeated use when wiring changes are needed. It is commonly available with orange lever handles, depending on stock and batch.

If you need a compact distribution connector that combines quick lever operation, reusable design, secure wire grip, and simple 1-to-4 branching, the WAGO NV-F14 is a practical choice for many electrical wiring applications.

When soldering or repairing electronics, the biggest challenge is keeping the board steady and your hands free. For PCB support and positioning, the fixture includes movable magnetic clips/pillars that can be repositioned as needed. This design makes it a practical assistant for holding printed circuit boards and adapting to different fixture layouts.

How to Use (Step‑by‑Step) | طريقة الاستخدام (خطوة بخطوة)
Placement: Set the unit on a flat, non‑flammable surface with clear airflow around the vents.
Fill: Place solder bars or pellets into the crucible. Start with smaller pieces for faster melt.
Power & Warm‑up: Switch ON, set dial to 5–6 for initial melt; wait until alloy is fully liquid.
Set temperature: Adjust between ~200–450 °C depending on alloy and flux. Keep the surface dross‑free by skimming.
Flux: Apply appropriate liquid flux to workpieces (e.g., Special Liquid Flux 250 mL).
Dip: Immerse the part 1–3 s or until wetting completes. Withdraw at a slight angle to shed excess solder.
Post‑process: Allow to cool; clean residues as per flux type (no‑clean typically requires none).

Label the dial positions that match your alloy (e.g., Sn63/Pb37 ~250–260 °C).

Molten solder is hot; wear heat‑resistant gloves, eye protection, and use fume extraction when working with active fluxes.

blocks.text: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 N8R2 – Dual USB-C Wi-Fi + BLE Development Board

The ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 N8R2 pairs the ESP32-S3 dual-core LX7 MCU with 8 MB QSPI Flash + 2 MB QSPI PSRAM, giving you enough headroom for advanced Wi-Fi/BLE projects, UI work, and ML/DSP sketches. The board exposes two independent USB functions—a classic USB-to-UART bridge and the SoC’s native USB 2.0 FS (USB-Serial-JTAG/OTG)—so you can power, flash, debug, and even make USB devices with a single cable. Most GPIOs are broken out on breadboard-friendly headers, with Boot/Reset buttons and a built-in RGB LED (GPIO48) for status.

Q1: What exactly does N8R2 mean?
A: N8 = 8 MB QSPI Flash; R2 = 2 MB QSPI PSRAM in the module variant.
Q2: Can I power and program from either USB port?
A: Yes. Both ports can power the board; use UART for classic flashing or native USB-Serial-JTAG for flashing/debug and USB device features.
Q3: Does the board break out most GPIOs?
A: Yes—most module pins are on headers; SPI flash/PSRAM pins remain dedicated.

CASE 1: Onboard Wiring Instructions for “Yellow” Wire connection
1. Thin Red Wire (VCC): positive pole of power supply input (4.5-30V)
(Note: if the measuring signal is less than 30V and the power is adequate, can be the power supply of module)
2. Thin Black Wire (GND): the negative pole of power supply input (4.5-30V, common ground with measuring signal)
3. Green Wire (VIN): positive pole of measuring signal input (0-100V)
4. Thick Red Wire (I ): positive pole of current input (series connect on the power supply cathode)
5. Thick Black Wire (I-): the negative pole of current input (series connect on the power supply cathode)
Note: If the input voltage is more than 5V then please use the buck converter.

(The current range of 10A requires the external shunt connection process)
1. Connect the lines which are not connected well, and do not touch other places.

2. The shunt is connected to the negative pole of the measuring system (the shunt itself does not distinguish the direction, and the connection is fixed to the two large screw holes in the distributor.
3. According to the current direction, the green line ( ) and the black line (-) of the three lines are respectively screwed on the two small screws of the shunt.
4. Connect the red line of the three lines to the positive pole of the measuring system.

5. The power supply line in the two lines is connected to the appropriate power supply (and the voltage between the black lines in the three lines. It is suggested to be connected to the 12V, at the same time, the electric power black lines in the two lines are wrapped with insulating tape, so do not encounter other places, so as not to cause a short circuit).

6. The above 1-5 steps are suitable for the use of common ground; for independent power supply occasions, the red and black lines of power supply in two lines are respectively connected to both sides of the positive and negative poles of the power supply (the power supply voltage <28V, suggested to be about 12V).

blocks.text: This 13V 0.5W Zener diode (axial DO‑35/DO‑204AH package) provides a stable reference around 13.0 V for regulation, clamping and over‑voltage protection. The device targets the popular 500 mW small‑signal Zener class (BZX55/BZX79/ZPD families). Nominal Zener voltage is specified at a test current of 5 mA, with ±5% tolerance (typical “C‑tolerance” range). It’s a simple, reliable building block for power rails, ADC references, and snubbers.

Why this value? Around 13 V the Zener exhibits a positive temperature coefficient typical of mid‑range voltages, making it suitable for general clamp/reference tasks while keeping dynamic impedance reasonably low.
Nominal Zener voltage: 13 V @ IZT = 5 mA (±5%)
Power dissipation: 0.5 W (at Tamb 25°C, derate with temperature)
Dynamic impedance (typ.): ≈11 Ω at IZT (5 mA)
Reverse leakage (25°C): in the sub‑µA range at specified VR ≈ 8.5 V (device‑family typical)
Values reflect the 0.5 W axial Zener diode family (BZX55/BZX79/ZPD class). For tight design margins, consult the batch datasheet supplied and apply thermal derating.

blocks.text: Derating: Reduce allowable power above 25°C ambient per manufacturer’s curve. Keep leads ≥4 mm and provide airflow for continuous dissipation.

A Zener diode in reverse bias stabilizes voltage once the junction reaches its breakdown region. For a target around 13 V, operate the device at a reasonable current (e.g., 2–10 mA) to keep the dynamic impedance low without exceeding the power limit.
Example: Clamp Vin_max = 24 V to VZ = 13 V at IZ ≈ 5 mA →
R ≈ (24 − 13)/0.005 = 2200 Ω (2.2 kΩ) and P_R ≈ 0.055 W. Use 2.2 kΩ, 0.25 W (or higher) as a safe choice.
Power check: P_Z ≈ VZ × IZ. With 13 V @ 5 mA → 65 mW average (OK). Ensure sum of power in worst conditions stays ≤ 0.5 W.
Noise & impedance: Higher IZ generally reduces impedance (and noise), but raises dissipation. For low‑noise references, add an RC filter after the Zener or consider dedicated references.

ekostra-14302.summary: ⚡ 4.7µF radial electrolytic capacitor 🔋 Rated voltage: 50V for reliable DC filtering 🧩 Ideal for power smoothing, decoupling, and timing circuits 🛠️ Through-hole radial leads—easy soldering on PCBs 📈 Helps reduce ripple and noise in power lines 📦 Compact size for general electronics projects 🔧 Common choice for repairs and prototyping ✅ Suitable for Arduino/analog/power supply circuits

blocks.text: The 4.7µF 50V radial electrolytic capacitor is a small polarized capacitor with a comfortable 50V rating. It is widely used for audio signal coupling, timing circuits, local supply smoothing and as the input or output capacitor of small voltage regulators.
Polarity marking: stripe on the sleeve marks the negative lead

Used as a coupling capacitor into an amplifier input of 10K Ohm, the low-frequency cut-off is f = 1 ÷ (2π × R × C) = 1 ÷ (2π × 10,000Ω × 4.7µF) ≈ 3.4 Hz. All audible frequencies pass, while the DC level between the two stages is blocked.
Signal coupling and DC blocking in audio and sensor circuits
Timing capacitor in 555 and RC timer circuits
Input/output capacitor for small linear regulators
Observe polarity: the longer lead is positive, and the striped side goes to the lower voltage (usually GND).
In coupling circuits, point the positive lead toward the side with the higher DC voltage.
Do not exceed 50V; leave a safety margin.
Electrolytic capacitors have wide tolerance; for precise timing, use a film capacitor instead.

ekostra-2925.summary: CD4021 8-Stage Static Shift Register 1. Function: 8-Stage Static Shift Register 2. Family: CD40xx CMOS Logic

blocks.text: The CD4021 is an 8-stage static shift register IC, shifting serial data in bit-by-bit through 8 static storage stages, letting a single serial line be converted to 8 parallel output lines.

Being static, the register retains its data indefinitely as long as power is applied, without needing a refresh clock, useful for parallel-to-serial or serial-to-parallel conversion in low-speed data expansion applications.
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family, this IC is a standard building block for serial/parallel data conversion circuits.
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family

blocks.text: The CD4053 is a CMOS triple 2-channel multiplexer/demultiplexer IC designed for both digital and analog signal switching. It features three independent single-pole double-throw (SPDT) switches controlled by a logic-level input, enabling the routing of signals from one common terminal to either of two selectable inputs/outputs. Each switch is bidirectional and can pass signals in either direction.
The CD4053 operates over a wide voltage range and is ideal for signal routing, analog multiplexing, audio switching, and low-voltage control systems.
Operates as both multiplexer and demultiplexer
Available in DIP-16 and SOIC-16 packages

int value = analogRead(A0); returns 0 to 1023 as you turn the knob. Because 100K is a high value, add a 100nF capacitor from the wiper to GND for steadier readings.
